designationHistory.name: World War I Memorial
designationHistory.indexText: Congress redesignated Pershing Park in Washington, D.C., as a World War I Memorial and let the World War I Centennial Commission enhance the site.
designationHistory.note: The 2014 act says 'World War I Memorial'; NPS and the NPS History Collection use 'National World War I Memorial'. No act adding 'National' was checked. The memorial was dedicated April 16, 2021 (NPS History Collection); dedication is not listed as a designation.

sources.name: NPS, The National Parks: Index 2012-2016, 'Redesignation of Pershing Park Dec. 19, 2014'
